dos.title: Enjoy free public transport nationwide
dos.description: Hop on any bus, tram, or train (2nd class) anywhere in the country without buying a ticket—it is completely free for everyone!

dos.title: Explore the Bock Casemates fortress tunnels
dos.description: Visit the UNESCO-listed underground fortifications carved directly into the sheer cliff walls of the Alzette valley.

dos.title: Greet in French, German, or Luxembourgish
dos.description: 'Moien' (Luxembourgish hello) or 'Bonjour' is customary when entering shops or restaurants.

donts.title: Don't sit in 1st class train coaches without a ticket
donts.description: While 2nd class public transit is completely free, 1st class carriages still require a valid ticket and are strictly checked.

donts.title: Don't assume everyone speaks only German or French
donts.description: Luxembourg is multilingual; residents comfortably switch between Luxembourgish, French, German, and English.

etiquette.tipping: Service is included by law in all bills; rounding up to the nearest euro or adding 5% for exceptional service is customary.
